title: Tehnike odgovora na incidente
summary: Tehnike odgovora na incident: planovi, playbookovi i vježbe, korelacija i obogaćivanje logova, trijaža i timeline, chain of custody i legal hold, izolacija, eskalacija, remedijacija sa verifikacijom, restore i root cause analiza.
summary_en: Incident response techniques: plans, playbooks, and exercises, log correlation and enrichment, triage and timeline, chain of custody and legal hold, isolation, escalation, remediation with verification, restoration, and root cause analysis.
